convert_scene_annotation_to_numpy: run the script to convert HITL annotation scene JSON files from S3 into numpy arrays for vision model training
convert_scene_with_batch_id: run the script with a batch_id to auto-discover and convert annotated scenes from the local .hitl directory
convert_scene_to_custom_path: run the script with a custom save_path to store the pickled model training data in a specific directory
review_main_scene_conversion: review the main function that downloads annotated scenes from S3, computes xyz offsets, and populates numpy block and tag arrays
refactor_main_s3_upload: refactor the main function to support alternative cloud storage backends instead of hardcoded S3 upload
